old_caption: The video captures a serene beach scene enveloped in a thick fog, creating an ethereal atmosphere. A group of people is scattered across the sandy shore, engaged in various activities. Some individuals are holding long sticks, seemingly involved in creating large soap bubbles that float gracefully through the air. The soap bubbles, illuminated by the soft light, shimmer with vibrant colors, adding a magical touch to the misty setting. Others appear to be walking or standing, possibly observing the soap bubble activity or simply enjoying the tranquil environment. The fog blankets the entire scene, obscuring the background and giving the impression of a dreamlike landscape. The overall mood is peaceful and whimsical, with the gentle movement of the soap bubbles and the quiet interaction among the people contributing to the serene ambiance.

caption: The video captures a foggy, low-contrast sandy beach where several small groups of people stand scattered in the haze. On the left, a large iridescent soap-bubble film hovers just above the sand, its rounded dome trailing a rainbow-sheened tail. Throughout the clip this bubble structure steadily drifts leftward, the dome flattening and lowering while the tail contracts and shifts toward the frame edge. In the center a person in a light top and dark trousers stands with both arms raised, holding two wands whose thin line is visible overhead, making only small pose adjustments as the film moves. Just behind them another figure in reddish clothing likewise holds wands aloft. On the right a person in a red shirt grips a horizontal wand, and a couple stands close together at the far edge. The whole scene stays muted, with the right-side figures remaining essentially stationary relative to one another.
